'that was ...') · þæt — that (neuter demonstrative pronoun, accusative singular, object of gewræc; spelled ðæt; ic ðæt eall gewræc 'I avenged all that')
ðā: sē/þā — the, those (nominative plural of the demonstrative); as adverb: then · þā — those, the (accusative plural of the demonstrative) · þā — when (conjunction; ðā ic of searwum cwōm 'when I came from') · þā — then (adverb; nū ðā 'just now') · þā — who, which (relative, nominative plural, referring to a plural antecedent) · þā — the (accusative singular feminine of the demonstrative before a noun; sē ðā sæcce genæs 'he who came through the strife')
ðām: sē — the, that (dative singular neuter of the demonstrative, before a noun) · sē — the, that (dative singular masculine of the demonstrative, before a noun; tō ðām lindplegan 'to the shield-play', of ðām goldsele) · sē — the, those (dative plural of the demonstrative, before a noun; ðām lēanum 'those rewards')
ðǣr: þǣr — there (adverb, here spelled ðǣr) · þǣr — where (relative adverb/conjunction; ðǣr git ... wada cunnedon 'where you two tried the waters')
ðȳ: þȳ — therefore, by that means (instrumental singular of the demonstrative sē, used as an adverb or conjunction; ðȳ hē ... ofercwōm 'for that reason he overcame') · þȳ — that (instrumental singular of the demonstrative, before a noun; ðȳ wǣpne 'that weapon', the case relation being uncertain) · þȳ — the (instrumental of the demonstrative, before a comparative; nō ðȳ ǣr 'none the sooner')
þone: sē — whom, that (accusative singular masculine of the demonstrative, here relative) · sē — that (accusative singular masculine of the demonstrative, qualifying a noun: þone hilderǣs 'that battle-rush') · sē — the (accusative singular masculine of the demonstrative used as an article before a weak superlative; þone sēlestan 'the best')
þæs: þæt — for that, of that (genitive singular of the demonstrative: 'comfort for that') · se — of the (genitive singular neuter article, before a noun: þæs recedes 'of the hall') · þes — this (demonstrative, nominative singular masculine; the manuscript's þæs for þes, in þæs sele 'this hall') · þæs — so, to that degree (genitive singular of the demonstrative used adverbially; þæs fæste 'so firmly') · þæs — of this (genitive, as object of wēndon: Þæs ne wēndon 'did not expect this') · þæs — as, according as (genitive singular of the demonstrative, with the relative particle: þæs þe 'in so far as, as')
þā: þā — then (adverb); also: those, the (plural demonstrative); who, which (relative) · when (conjunction) · þā — the (accusative singular feminine of the demonstrative before a noun)
þām: sē/þæt — them, those; that (dative of the demonstrative) · sē — the (dative singular masculine, before a noun; wið þām āglǣcan 'against the awesome one')
þāra: sē — of those (genitive plural of the demonstrative)
þē: þe — which, that (relative particle; Klaeber prints þē, emended — the MS has only 'þ') · þū — you (dative singular: to you, with you) · þū — you (accusative singular; þæt ic þē sōhte 'that I should seek you') · sē — the, by that (instrumental singular of the demonstrative, before a comparative; þē geornor 'the more clearly') · þū — you, yourself (reflexive dative; þū þē self 'you yourself') · þe — when, after (relative particle, if þē is taken as the sense of the clause requires; þē se āglǣca ... gewand 'when the awesome one ... turned', where several editors print þā; a guess)
þēah: þēah — though, although (conjunction; cf. 'though') · þēah — however, nevertheless (adverb; swā þēah 'even so, yet')
þēoden: þēoden — lord, chief of a people (accusative singular; from þēod 'people') · þēoden — lord (vocative singular) · þēoden — lord, prince (masculine, nominative singular)
þǣr: þǣr — there (adverb) · þǣr — where (relative adverb; þǣr ic fīfe geband 'where I bound five') · þǣr — if, provided that (conjunction; þǣr hē meahte swā 'if he could so')
āna: āna — alone (adverb; āna wið eallum 'alone against all') · āna — alone, sole (adjective, nominative singular masculine, agreeing with hrōf)
āre: ār — favour, mercy, help (feminine, accusative singular, object of gelȳfde; tō Anwaldan āre 'the favour of the Almighty')
ēcean: ēce — eternal (adjective, dative singular masculine, weak; ēcean Dryhtne 'to the eternal Lord')
ēstum: ēst — favour, grace, kindness (dative plural, of manner: 'with favours')
ūtan: ūtan — from outside, outside (adverb; innan ond ūtan 'inside and out')
ǣnige: ǣnig — any (adjective, an instrumental or accusative form in the fixed phrase ǣnige þinga 'in any respect'; þinga is a genitive plural, so the two do not agree)
ǣr: ǣr — before, previously (adverb; cf. archaic 'ere') · ǣr — before (conjunction; ǣr gē 'before you') · ǣr — sooner, earlier (adverb, with a comparative sense; nō þȳ ǣr 'none the sooner') · ǣr — before (preposition with dative; ǣr dēaþe 'before death')
ǣrgōd: ǣrgōd — good from of old, preeminently good (adjective; ǣr 'before, of old' + gōd)
